# Building machine: wave 4 areas (7 October 2026)

**Status: wave 4 is merged** into `prod/compose` on 7 October 2026 (ten worker branches on top of pushed wave 3 `ad78c593`; migrations 37 to 41, aggregate `0023_platform_core.sql`). Wave 4a (LIFE-03, LIFE-04, LIFE-05/06, COST-01/02, OPS-02, OPS-05/06) was branched from `c9a942d6`, before wave 3, so its merges were composed with the wave-3 execution core; wave 4b (K8S-CONN, OPS-03, MIX-01/02, MIX-03/04) was branched from `ad78c593`. Live cloud acceptance is deferred by the user: every live harness is gated and skips with a stated reason. Verification instructions: [VERIFY-QUEUE.md](VERIFY-QUEUE.md), section Wave 4 (it starts with the steps the verifier must do first).

For the verifying agent. Pull and merge (`git pull --no-rebase`) before every push. Avoid editing the areas below unless a verification fix truly requires it; if you must, keep it minimal and note it in RESULTS so the builder merges carefully.
